newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA sets dividend, share split.
newsitem.headline: ICA sets dividend, share split.

text.p: Empresas ICA, said on Tuesday it will pay a 1.35 pesos per share for its annual cash dividend.
It also said the company's shareholders had approved a share split.
The share split of six new shares for each existing share was approved during an extraordinary shareholder meeting, the company said in a statement.
"Once the share split is effective, each ADR will represent six CPO (shares); each CPO will continue to represent a financial interest in one share held in the CPO Trust," it said.
The split was intended to maintain a stable ADR price, it added.
The dividend will be paid in two payments. The first dividend, of 0.65 peso per share, will be paid on April 30.
The second 0.70 peso per share payment will be made during 1997, at a date to be decided later, it said.
